items.body: Evening strolls through Alfama offer moments of calm reflection as the day's mild warmth slowly dissipates into the damp night air. Fado melodies drift from small doorways as local musicians tune their guitars for the evening service. The 10 to 22°C temperature range makes a light jacket sufficient for navigating the steep, stair-lined alleys of the old quarters.
